English: Currently, there is no vaccine or approved treatment for this emerging infection; thus, the objective of this study is to design a multiepitope peptide vaccine against COVID-19 using an immunoinformatics approach.

Yoruba: Nísisìnyí, kò sí àjẹsára tàbí ìtọ́jú tí a bọwọ́ lù fún aàrùn yí; nítorí náà, kókó ìwádìí yìí ni láti ṣẹ̀dá àjẹsára afáralókun-ìgbóguntàrùn láti lè kọjú ìjà sí COVID-19 nípa lílo ìlàna imunoiǹfọmátíikì.

Hausa: A halin yanzu, babu alluran rigakafi ko maganin da aka yarda da shi don wannan kamuwa da cuta da ke fitowa; don haka, makasudin wannan binciken shine a tsara allurar peptide multiepitope akan COVID-19 ta amfani da tsarin rigakafi.

Hausa: An yi amfani da fasahohi da yawa waɗanda ke sauƙaƙe haɗakar tsarin rigakafi da tsarin kwatancen genomic don tantance yuwuwar peptides don tsara maganin peptide na tushen T-cell epitope ta amfani da furotin ambulan na 2019-nCoV a matsayin manufa.

English: Additionally, ten peptides binding to MHC class I and MHC class II were found to be promising candidates for vaccine design with adequate world population coverage of 88.5% and 99.99%, respectively.

Yoruba: Láfikún, ìdi pẹ́pútáìdì mẹ́wàá sí kíláàsì MHC I àti kíláàsì MHC II ni wọ́n ri pé wọ́n ń yege fún àjẹsára pẹ̀lú iye ẹni tó wà lágbàáyé tó tó 88.5% àti 99.99% lọ́kan-ò-jọ̀kan.

Zulu: Abacwaningi baseSudan bakha umuthi wokugomela i-COVID-19 ongaba khona
Hausa: Masu binciken Sudan sun tsara yiwuwar rigakafin COVID-19
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba naga ga Sudan ba akanyetša moento wo o ka lwantšhago COVID-19
Amharic: የሱዳን ተመራማሪዎች ለኮቪድ-19 መፍትሄ ሊሆን የሚችል ክትባት ሰርተዋል

English: Summary Body Text
Luganda: Ebinnyonnyola Ebifunza
Yoruba: Summary Body Text
Zulu: Summary Body Text
Hausa: Summary Body Text
Northern Sotho: Summary Body Text
Amharic: Summary Body Text

English: In 2020, before vaccines against COVID-19 were readily available, researchers in Sudan proposed a vaccine that would stimulate an immune response against the envelope protein of the SARS-CoV-2 virus.
Luganda: Mu 2020, ng’eddagala erigema COVID-19 terinnaba kukolebwa, abanoonyereza mu Sudan baateesa okukola eddagala erigema erisobola okukola obusibage eri puloteni ya envelope ey’akawuka ka SARS-CoV-2.
Yoruba: Ní ọdún 2020, kí àjẹsára tí ń gbógun ti COVID-19 tó wà lárọ́wọ́tó, àwọn olùṣèwádìí ní Sudan dábàá àjẹsára kan tí yóò fára lókun àti gbógun ti ìwémọ́ purotéènì aàrun SARS-CoV-2 náà.
Zulu: Ngo-2020, ngaphambi kokuthi imigomo yokugomela i-COVID-19 itholakale kalula, abacwaningi baseSudan bahlongoze umuthi wokugoma ozovuselela ukuzivikela komzimba ngokumelene nephrotheni yemvilophu yegciwane le-SARS-CoV-2.
Hausa: A cikin 2020, kafin a samar da allurar rigakafin cutar ta COVID-19, masu bincike a Sudan sun ba da shawarar allurar rigakafin da za ta haifar da martanin rigakafi daga furotin ambulan na kwayar cutar SARS-CoV-2.
Northern Sotho: Ka 2020, pele ga ge meento ye e lwantšhago COVID-19 e be e hwetšagala, banyakišiši ba Sudan ba šišintše moento woo o ka matlafatšago go itšhireletša ga mašole a mmele kgahlanong le omfolopo ya protheine ya baerase ya SARS-CoV-2.
Amharic: በ2020 የኮቪድ-19 ክትባቶች በብዛት ከመስፋፋታቸው በፊት በሱዳን የሚገኙ ተመራማሪዎች በሳርስ-ኮቫ-2 ቫይረስ ታቅፎ በሚገኘው ፕሮቲን ላይ የበሽታ መከላከል ምላሽን ማነሳሳት የሚችል ክትባት ለመስራት ሃሳብ አቅርበው ነበር፡፡

English: At the time, many researchers were looking for potential safe and effective vaccines against COVID-19, which had just begun spreading rapidly around the world.
Luganda: Mu kiseera ekyo, abanoonyereza bangi baali banoonya eddagala eriyinza okukola obulungi era nga teririna bulabe mu kugema COVID-19, eyali yaakatandika okusaasaanira ku misinde emingi okwetooloola ensi.
Yoruba: Lásìkò yí, ọ̀pọ̀ olùṣèwádìí ni ó ń wá àjẹsára tó ń ṣiṣẹ́ tí kò si léwu ní lílò láti gbógun ti COVID-19, tí ó ṣẹ̀ ń tànkálẹ̀ káàkiri àgbáyé.
Zulu: Ngaleso sikhathi, abacwaningi abaningi bebefuna imigomo ephephile nesebenzayo yokugomela i-COVID-19, eyayisanda kuqala ukusabalala ngokushesha emhlabeni wonke jikelele.
Hausa: A lokacin, masu bincike da yawa suna neman yuwuwar amintattun allurar rigakafin cutar COVID-19, wanda ya fara yaduwa cikin sauri a duniya.
Northern Sotho: Ka nakong yeo, bontši bja banyakišiši ba be ba nyakana le meento ye e ka šomago ka polokego le ka tshwanelo kgahlanong le COVID-19, yeo e sa tšwago go phatlalala ka lebelo go kgabaganya lefase.
Amharic: በጊዜው ገና በአለም ዙሪያ መስፋፋት እየጀመረ እንዳለ ብዙ ተመራማሪዎች ደህንነቱ የተጠበቀ እና ኮቪድ-19ን ለመከላከል በሚገባ ሊሰራ የሚችል ክትባት እየፈለጉ ነበር፡፡

English: Peptide-based vaccines are a safe and cheaper alternative compared to other types of vaccines.
Luganda: Eddagala erigema eryesigamiziddwa ku peptide teririna bulabe era si lya buseere bw’oligeraageranya ku bika by’eddagala erigema eddala.
Yoruba: Àjẹsára adálórí-pẹ́pútáìdi kò léwu wọ́n sì jẹ́ olówó pọ́kú tí a bá ṣe àfiwé wọn pẹ̀lú irúfẹ́ àwọn àjẹsára mìíràn.
Zulu: Imithi yokugoma esekelwe ku-peptide iyindlela ephephile futhi eshibhile uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye izinhlobo zemithi yokugoma.
Hausa: Alurar rigakafin peptide hanya ce mai aminci kuma mai rahusa idan aka kwatanta da sauran nau'ikan rigakafin.
Northern Sotho: Meento ye e theilwego godimo ga phepothaete ke mekgwa ye mengwe ye e bolokegilego ebile e rekegago ge go bapetšwa le mehuta ye mengwe ya meento.
Amharic: ፔፕታይድ ላይ የተመሰረቱ ክትባቶች ከሌሎች ክትባቶች ጋር ሲነጻጸሩ ደህንነታቸው የተጠበቀ እና ርካሽ አማራጮች ናቸው፡፡

English: Peptides are short strings of amino acids and these amino acids are the building blocks of proteins, which contain multiple peptides.
Luganda: Peptide buba bujegere obumpi obwa asidi za amino nga asidi za amino zino bwe butaffaali obukola puloteni, nga puloteni zibaamu peptide nnyingi.
Yoruba: Àwọn pẹ́pútáìdi jẹ́ àmínó asiìdì kékèké àti pé àwọn àmínó asiìdì wọ̀nyí jẹ́ òkúta ìmọlé fún purotéènì, léyìí tó ní pẹ́putáìdì púpọ̀.
Zulu: Ama-peptide ayizintambo ezimfishane zama-amino acid futhi lawa ma-amino acid ayizakhi zamaprotheni, aqukethe ama-peptide amaningi.
Hausa: Peptides gajeru ne na amino acid kuma waɗannan amino acid sune tubalan gina jiki na sunadaran, waɗanda ke ɗauke da peptides da yawa.
Northern Sotho: Diphepothaete ke dithapo tše kopana tša diamino esiti gomme diamino esiti tše ke methopo ya diprotheine, tše di nago le diphepothaete tše ntši.
Amharic: ፔፕታይዶች አጭር የአሚኖ አሲድ ሰንሰለቶች ሲሆኑ እነዚህ አሚኖ አሲዶች ብዙ ፔፕታይዶችን የሚይዙት ፕሮቲኖች የሚሰሩባቸው ገንቢ መሳሪያዎች ናቸው፡፡

English: An epitope is a target peptide that can be recognised by the body's immune system.
Luganda: Epitope ye peptide eruubirirwa ng’esobola okukengebwa obusibage bw’omubiri.
Yoruba: Ẹ́pítóòpù jẹ́ àfojúsùn pẹ́pútáìdi tí ẹ̀ka ìgboguntàrùn inú ará lè dá mọ̀.
Zulu: I-epitope iyi-peptide eqondiwe engabonwa amasosha omzimba.
Hausa: Epitope shi ne peptide wanda tsarin garkuwar jiki zai iya gane shi.
Northern Sotho: Ephiphoupu ke phepothaete ye e nepilwego yeo e ka lemogwago ke mašole a mmele.
Amharic: ኤፒቶፕ ማለት ኢላማ ፔፕታይድ ሲሆን በሰውነታችን በሽታን የመከላከል ሲስተም ተለይቶ ይታወቃል፡፡

English: Peptide-based vaccines make use of epitopes from the part of the virus that causes an immune response in the body, in this case the envelope protein, or E protein.
Luganda: Eddagala erigemwa eryesigamiziddwa ku peptide likozesa epitope okuva mu kitundu ky’akawuka ekizuukusa obusibage bw’omubiri, nga mu ngeri eno y’ebeera puloteni ya envelope, oba puloteni ya E.
Yoruba: Àjẹsára adálórí-pẹ́pútáìdi máa ń ṣàmúlò ẹ́pítóòpù látara aàrun tó fa ̀sì ìgbóguntàrùn inú ara, ̀yí tí í ṣe ìwémọ́ purotéènì, tàbí purotéènì E.
Zulu: Imithi yokugoma esekelwe ku-peptide isebenzisa ama-epitopi asuka engxenyeni yegciwane ebangela ukusabela komzimba emzimbeni, kulokhu iphrotheni yemvilophu, noma iphrotheni engu-E.
Hausa: Allurar rigakafin peptide suna amfani da epitopes daga ɓangaren ƙwayoyin cuta wanda ke haifar da amsawar rigakafi a cikin jiki, a wannan yanayin furotin ambulan, ko furotin E.
Northern Sotho: Meento ye e theilwego godimo ga phepothaete e šomiša diephithoupu go tšwa go karolo ya baerase ye e hlolago go itšhireletša ga mašole a mmele, mo go bolelwa ka omfolopo ya protheine, goba E protheine.
Amharic: ፔፕታይድ ላይ የተመሰረቱ ክትባቶች ከቫይረሱ በሽታን የመከላከል ምላሽ ከሚያስከስተው የተወሰነ የሰውነት ክፍል ላይ የሚገኙ ኤፒቶፖችን ይጠቀማሉ፡፡ በዚህኛው አጋጣሚ ይሄ የታቀፈው ፕሮቲን ወይም  E ፕሮቲን ነው፡፡

English: The E protein forms part of the protein coat (“cover”) surrounding the virus.
Luganda: Puloteni ya E y’emu ku bikola olususu lwa puloteni (“eddiba”) olwetooloola akawuka.
Yoruba: Àwọn purotéènì E náà jẹ́ ẹ̀ya akópa nínú àpapọ̀ purotéèni (́”ìdàbò”) tó yí aàrùn náà ka.
Zulu: Iphrotheni engu-E iyingxenye yesikhuma sephrotheni (“ikhava”) esizungeze igciwane.
Hausa: Sunan furotin E ya zama wani ɓangare na gashin furotin ("rufin") da ke kewaye da ƙwayar cuta.
Northern Sotho: Protheine ya E e bopa karolo ya legapi la protheine (“seširo”) ye e dikologilego baerase.
Amharic: E ፕሮቲን ቫይረሱን ከቦ የሚገኘውን ፕሮቲን ኮት (“ሽፋን”) የተወሰነ አካል ይሰራል፡፡

English: This protein plays a key role in how the virus infects cells and how it causes disease.
Luganda: Puloteni eno ya mugaso nnyo mu ngeri akawuka gye kalyamu obutoffaali n’engeri gye kaleetamu obulwadde.
Yoruba: Purotéènì náà ni ipa tí ó ń kó lórí I bí aàrun náà ṣe nípá tó lórí àwọn sẹ́ẹ̀lì̀ àti bí ó ṣe ń fa àìsàn.
Zulu: Le phrotheni idlala indima ebalulekile endleleni igciwane elithelela ngayo izakhi zomzimba nokuthi lizidala kanjani izifo.
Hausa: Wannan furotin yana taka muhimmiyar rawa a yadda kwayar cutar ke cutar da kwayoyin halitta da kuma yadda take haifar da cututtuka.
Northern Sotho: Protheine ye e kgatha tema ye bohlokwa mabapi le ka moo baerase e fetetšago disele le ka moo e hlolago bolwetši.
Amharic: ይሄ ፕሮቲን ቫይረሱ ሴሎችን ኢንፌክት የሚያደርግበትን መንገድ እና በሽታ ማስከሰቱ ላይ ወሳኝ ሚና ይጫወታል፡፡

English: The researchers in this study aimed to design a peptide-based vaccine by comparing the genetic sequences of peptides shared between different coronavirus strains, using the envelope (E) protein as a target.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza mu kunoonyereza kuno baagenderera okukola eddagala erigema eryesigamiziddwa ku peptide nga bageraageranya enziriŋŋana ya peptide ebisangibwa mu bika by’akawuka ka corona eby’enjawulo, nga bakozesa puloteni ya envelope (E) ng’ekiruubirirwa.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùṣèwádìí iṣẹ́ yìí ń gbèrò àti ṣe àjẹsára adálórí-pẹ́pútáìdi nípa ṣíṣe ìfiwéra ìtẹ̀lé-ǹ-tẹ̀lé jíìnì pẹ́pútáìdi tí a pín láàárín àsopọ aàrun kòrónà, nípa ṣíṣàmúlò ìwémọ́ (E) purotéènì gẹ́gẹ́ bí àfojúsùn.
Zulu: Abacwaningi kulolu cwaningo bahlose ukuklama umgomo osuselwa ku-peptide ngokuqhathanisa ukulandelana kofuzo kwama-peptide okwabiwe phakathi kwezinhlobo ezahlukahlukene ze-coronavirus, kusetshenziswa amaprotheni emvilophu (E) njengokuhlosiwe.
Hausa: Masu binciken a cikin wannan binciken sun yi niyyar tsara maganin rigakafin peptide ta hanyar kwatanta jerin kwayoyin peptides da aka raba tsakanin nau'ikan coronavirus daban-daban, ta amfani da furotin (E) a matsayin manufa.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ka dinyakišišong tše ba be ba nepile go akanyetša moento wo o theilwego godimo ga phepothaete ka go bapetša ditatelantšho tša diphepothaete tša tlhamegotšini magareng ga mehuta ye e fapafapanego ya coronavirus, ka go šomiša omfolopo ya (E) ya protheine bjalo ka tebanywa.
Amharic: የዚህ ጥናት ተመራማሪዎች በተለያዩ የኮሮና ቫይረስ ስትሬኖች ላይ የታቀፈውን ፕሮቲን (E) እንደ ኢላማ ተጠቅመው የፔፕታይዶቹን የጄኔቲክ አወቃቀር በማወዳደር ፔፕታይድ ላይ የተመሰረተ ክትባትን መቅረጽ አቅደው ነበር፡፡

English: First they searched databases for the genetic sequences of potential peptide targets.
Luganda: Okusooka baakebera mu materekero okufuna ebikwata ku ndagabutonde za peptide eziyinza okuluubirirwa.
Yoruba: Lákọ̀ọ́kọ́ wọ́n wo àpapọ̀ dátà fún ìtẹ̀lé-ǹ-tẹ̀lé gíìni àwọn ohun tí ó lè jẹ́ àfojúsùn pẹ́pútáìdì.
Zulu: Okokuqala baseshe isizindalwazi ukuze bathole ukulandelana kwezakhi zofuzo okungase kuqondiswe kuma-peptide.
Hausa: Da farko sun bincika bayanan bayanai don jerin kwayoyin halitta masu yuwuwar harin peptide.
Northern Sotho: Sa pele ba phuruphutše didathapeisi go ditatelantšho tša ditlhamegotšini tša tšeo e ka bago ditebanywa tša phepothaete.
Amharic: በመጀመሪያ እጩ ሊሆኑ የሚችሉ የፔፕታይድ ኢላማዎችን ጄኔቲክ አወቃቀር ለማወቅ የመረጃ ቋቱን ፈትሸዋል፡፡

English: Next, they used computer models and their knowledge about how vaccines stimulate an immune response to identify genetic sequences that could be used to design a vaccine.
Luganda: Ekiddako, baakozesa emitetenkanyirizo gya kompyuta n’ebyo bye bamanyi ku ngeri eddagala erigema gye likolamu okusobola okufuna endagabutonde eziyinza okukozesebwa okukola eddagala erigema.
Yoruba: Síwájú sí i, wọ́n lo módẹ́ẹ̀lì kọ̀m̀pútà àti ìmọ wọn lórí I bí àjẹsára ṣe máa ń ṣe ìtají èsi ìgbóguntàìsàn láti ṣe ìdámọ̀ ìtẹ̀lé-ǹ-tẹ̀lé gíìni tí a lè lò láti ṣẹ̀dá a àjẹsára.
Zulu: Okulandelayo, basebenzise amamodeli ekhompiyutha kanye nolwazi lwabo ngokuthi imithi yokugoma ivuselela kanjani ukusabela komzimba ukuze babone ukulandelana kofuzo okungasetshenziswa ukuklama umgomo.
Hausa: Bayan haka, sun yi amfani da tsarin kwamfuta da iliminsu game da yadda alluran rigakafi ke motsa martanin rigakafi don gano jerin kwayoyin halitta waɗanda za a iya amfani da su don tsara maganin.
Northern Sotho: Se latelago, ba šomišitše dimmotlolo tša khomphutha le tsebo ya bona mabapi le ka moo meento e ka matlafatšago boikarabelo bja mašole a mmele go lemoga ditatelantšho tša ditlhamegotšini tšeo di ka šomišwago go tšweletša moento.
Amharic: በመቀጠል፣ ክትባት ለመስራት ሊጠቅም የሚችለውን የጄኔቲክ አወቃቀር ለማወቅ የኮምፒዩተር ሞዴሎችን እና ክትባቶች እንዴት የበሽታ መከላከል ምላሽን እንደሚያነሳሱ ያላቸውን እውቀት ተጠቅመዋል፡፡

English: The researchers were able to identify a number of peptides shared between different coronavirus strains that have the potential to be used as vaccines, but settled on the E protein as their vaccine candidate.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baasobola okuzuula peptide eziwerako ezisangibwa mu bika by’akawuka ka corona eby’enjawulo ezisobola okukozesebwa ng’eddagala erigema, naye ne banywerera ku puloteni ya E ng’eddagala lyabwe erigema.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùṣèwádìí i náà ṣe ìdámọ̀ pẹ́pútáìdì kọ̀ọ̀kan tí ó wà lára àpapọ̀ àwọn aàrun kòrónà tí ó lè jẹ́ lílò fún àjẹsára, àmọ́ tí ó sinlẹ̀ lórí i purotéènì E gẹ́gẹ́ bí i àyo àjẹsára wọn.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bakwazile ukukhomba inqwaba yama-peptide okwabelwanwa ngawo phakathi kwezinhlobo ezahlukene zokhuvethe ezinamandla okusetshenziswa njengemgomo, kodwa bazinza ku-E protein njengekhandidethi lokugoma.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun sami damar gano adadin peptides da aka raba tsakanin nau'ikan coronavirus daban-daban waɗanda ke da yuwuwar a yi amfani da su azaman rigakafin, amma sun daidaita kan furotin E a matsayin ɗan takarar rigakafin su.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba kgonne go lemoga palo ya diphepothaete tše di abelanwego magareng ga mehuta tša go fapafapana tša coronavirus tše di ka šomišwago bjalo ka meento, eupša ba dumelelana ka E protheine bjalo ka moento wo o hlahlobjago.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እንደ ክትባት ጥቅም ላይ መዋል የሚችሉ በተለያዩ የኮሮና ቫይረስ ስትሬኖች ውስጥ በተመሳሳይነት የሚገኙ የተወሰኑ ፔፕታይዶችን ለይተው አውቀዋል፤ ግን በመጨረሻ እንደ ክትባት እጩ የመረጡት E ፕሮቲንን ነው፡፡

English: They say they successfully designed a protein-based vaccine against COVID-19 using the sequence of this envelope protein.
Luganda: Bagamba nti baasobola okukola eddagala erigema COVID-19 eryesigamiziddwa ku puloteni nga bakozesa obukole bwa puloteni ya ennvelope eno.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ní àwọn yege láti ṣẹ̀dá àjẹsára adálóríi-purotéènì tí ó lè gbógun ti COVID-19 nípa ìṣàmúlò oníṣíṣẹ̀ǹtẹ̀lé ìwémọ́ purotéènì náà.
Zulu: Bathi baklame ngempumelelo umgomo we-COVID-19 osuselwa kumaprotheni besebenzisa ukulandelana kwaleli phrotheni lemvilophi.
Hausa: Sun ce sun yi nasarar tsara maganin rigakafin cutar ta COVID-19 ta hanyar yin amfani da jeri na wannan furotin ambulan.
Northern Sotho: Ba bolela gore ba kgonne go tšweletša ka katlego moento wo o theilwego godimo ga protheine go lwantšha COVID-19 ba šomiša tatelantšho ya protheine ye ya omfolopo.
Amharic: ይህን የታቀፈ ፕሮቲን አወቃቀር በመጠቀም ኮቪድ-19ን የሚከላከል ፕሮቲን ላይ የተመሰረተ ክትባት በተሳካ ሁኔታ መንደፍ ችለናል ይላሉ፡፡

English: At the time, researchers said they were the first to identify parts of the envelope (E) protein (peptides) as vaccine candidates for COVID-19.
Luganda: Mu kiseera ekyo, abanoonyereza baagamba nti be baasooka okuzuula ebitundu bya puloteni ya envelope (E) (peptides) ng’ebisobola okukolwamu eddagala erigema COVID-19.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùṣèwádìí náà sọ pé àwọn ni ọ̀wọ́ tó kọ́kọ́ ṣàwárí apá ìwépọ́ (E) purotéèni (pẹ́pútáìdì)̀ náà gẹ́gẹ́ bí I àjẹsára fún COVID-19.
Zulu: Ngaleso sikhathi, abacwaningi bathi babengabokuqala ukuhlonza izingxenye zemvilophu (E) protein (peptides) njengabazogomela i-COVID-19.
Hausa: A lokacin, masu binciken sun ce su ne farkon waɗanda suka gano sassan furotin (E) ambulan (peptides) a matsayin masu neman rigakafin COVID-19.
Northern Sotho: Nakong yeo, banyakišiši ba boletše gore e bile bona ba mathomo go lemoga dikarolo tša protheine ya omfolopo ya (E) (diphepothaetse) bjalo ka meento ye e lekwago ya COVID-19.
Amharic: በጊዜው ተመራማሪዎቹ ለኮቪድ-19 እጩ ክትባት የሆነውን የታቀፈውን የ(E) ፕሮቲን (ፔፕታይዶች) የተወሰኑ ክፍሎች ለይቶ ለማወቅ የመጀመሪያዎቹ ነን ይላሉ፡፡

English: Their findings highlighted the potential of protein-based vaccines, which were safe, new, affordable and an effective way of developing a new vaccine against COVID-19.
Luganda: Bye baazuula bino byalaga obusobozi bw’eddagala erigema eryesigamiziddwa ku puloteni, nga lino teririna bulabe, ppya, lifunika, era nga y’emu ku ngeri ennungi ey’oukola eddagala eppya erigema COVID-19.
Yoruba: Binciken nasu ya nuna yuwuwar allurar rigakafin furotin, waɗanda ke da aminci, sababbi, araha da kuma ingantacciyar hanyar haɓaka sabuwar rigakafin cutar ta COVID-19.
Zulu: Abakutholile kugqamise amandla emigomo esekelwe kumaprotheni, ebiphephile, entsha, engabizi futhi eyindlela esebenzayo yokwenza umgomo we-COVID-19.
Hausa: Binciken nasu ya nuna yuwuwar allurar rigakafin furotin, waɗanda ke da aminci, sababbi, araha da kuma ingantacciyar hanyar haɓaka sabuwar rigakafin cutar ta COVID-19.
Northern Sotho: Dikutollo tša bona di laeditše bokgoni bja meento ye e theilwego godimo ga protheine, yeo e bego e bolokegile, ye meswa, ya go rekega le go ba tsela ye kaone ya go tšweletša moento o moswa twantšhong ya COVID-19.
Amharic: ግኝታቸው ፕሮቲን ላይ የተመሰረቱ ክትባቶች ያላቸውን አቅም አሳይቷል፤ እነሱም ደህንነታቸው የተጠበቀ፣ አዲስ ፣ ዋጋቸው ተመጣጣኝ እና ኮቪድ-19ን ለመከላከል አዲስ ክትባትን ለመስራት ውጤታማ መንገድ ናቸው፡፡

English: However, their vaccine candidate would still have needed to be tested further in a clinical environment to make sure it was safe and effective.
Luganda: Wabula, eddagala lyabwe erigema lyali era lyetaaga okwongera okugezesebwa mu nkola y’ekisawo okukakasa nti likola bulungi era nga teririna bulabe.
Yoruba: Àmọ́ sá, àjẹsára wọn yóò ní láti jẹ́ yíyẹ̀wò síwáju ní agbègbe ìmọ́tótó́ láti ri dájú pé ó dára fún lílò ó ṣì yèkooro.
Zulu: Nokho-ke, ikhandidethi labo lokugoma belizodinga ukuthi liphinde lihlolwe endaweni yomtholampilo ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi uphephile futhi yasebenza.
Hausa: Koyaya, ɗan takararsu na rigakafin zai kasance yana buƙatar ƙarin gwaji a cikin yanayin asibiti don tabbatar da lafiya da tasiri.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjalo, moento wa bona wo o lekwago go be go letetšwe gore go tla hlokega gore se dirwe diteko gape ka lekaleng la diteko tša kalafo go kgonthiša gore se bolokegile ebile se šoma ka tshwanelo.
Amharic: ነገር ግን የክትባት እጯቸው ደህንነቱን እና ውጤታማነቱን ለማረጋገጥ በክሊኒክ ውስጥ በበለጠ ሁኔታ መፈተሽ ያስፈልገው ነበር፡፡

English: According to the Sudanese research team behind this study, protein vaccines are relatively inexpensive to develop, so they have great potential to be developed and distributed in developing countries.
Luganda: Okusinziira ku banoonyereza b’e Sudan abaali emabega w’okunoonyereza kuno, eddagala erigema eryesigamiziddwa ku puloteni si lya buseere okukola, noolwekyo kyangu okulikola n’okulibunyisa mu mawanga agakyakula.
Yoruba: Gẹ́gẹ́ bí ọ̀wọ́ olùṣèwádìí ilẹ̀ Sudan tó wà nídìí iṣẹ́ yìí, àwọn àjẹsára oní purot́ènì kò wọ́n láti ṣẹ̀dá, nítorí náà wó lè di ṣíṣẹ àti pínpín ní àwọn ìlú tí wọ́n ṣè ń ní ìdàgbàsókè yó yèkooro.
Zulu: Ngokusho kwethimba labacwaningi baseSudan abenza lolu cwaningo, imithi yokugoma amaprotheni ibiza kancane ukuyithuthukisa, ngakho-ke inamandla amakhulu okuthuthukiswa futhi isatshalaliswe emazweni asathuthuka.
Hausa: A cewar tawagar binciken Sudan da ke bayan wannan binciken, alluran rigakafin furotin ba su da tsada don haɓakawa, don haka suna da damar haɓakawa da rarraba su a ƙasashe masu tasowa.
Northern Sotho: Go ya ka sehlopha sa dinyakišišo sa Sudan se se etilego pele dinyakišišo tše, meento ya protheine ga e hloke tšhelete ye ntši go ka tšweletšwa, ka gona kgonagalo ke e ntši gore e tšweletšwe e be e phatlalatšwe go dinaga tše di hlabologago.
Amharic: ከዚህ ጥናት ጀርባ በነበሩት የሱዳን የምርምር ቡድን አባላት መሰረት በአንጻራዊ ደረጃ የፕሮቲን ክትባቶች ለመስራት ርካሽ ስለሆኑ በታዳጊ ሃገሮች ውስጥ ተመርተው የመከፋፈል አቅም አላቸው፡፡
